UPDATE dms_merchant_account SET frozen_amount=frozen_amount-#{amount},available_amount=available_amount+CASE WHEN debt_amount>=#{amount} THEN 0 ELSE #{amount}-debt_amount END,debt_amount=CASE WHEN debt_amount>=#{amount} THEN debt_amount-#{amount} ELSE 0 END,update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND frozen_amount>=#{amount}
